slides.title: "What do you do?"
slides.footer: Save it · Use it in interviews

slides.en: I'm a nurse.
slides.use: The simplest answer: I'm a / an + job.
slides.tip: Don't forget a / an: I'm an engineer, I'm a teacher.

slides.en: I work as an accountant.
slides.use: A more professional way to say your job.
slides.tip: work as + a / an + job.

slides.en: I work for a small company in Agadir.
slides.tip: work for + company · work in + place or field (in a bank, in marketing).

slides.en: I'm a student. I study computer science.
slides.tip: study + subject, with no "the".

slides.en: I'm looking for a job at the moment.
slides.use: If you don't work right now.
slides.tip: Present continuous: it's happening now.

slides.title: So,
slides.body: Write your answer in English in the comments. I'll reply to every one.
slides.meta: Adults · A1 → C1 · Online & in Agadir

posts.caption:
"What do you do?" means "What's your job?" 💼

1. I'm a nurse.
2. I work as an accountant.
3. I work for a small company in Agadir.
4. I'm a student. I study computer science.
5. I'm looking for a job at the moment.
